rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Data Storage on Device
rules.description: Detects mobile app data storage issues including unencrypted SQLite databases and shared preferences
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'data_storage' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Network Communication
rules.description: Detects mobile apps communicating over HTTP, using weak TLS, or accepting self-signed certificates
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'network' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Hardcoded Credentials in Binary
rules.description: Detects hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens in mobile app binaries or configuration files
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "mobile" or Message contains "hardcoded" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MOB-003

rules.name: Mobile — Local Privilege Escalation (Root/Jailbreak)
rules.description: Detects mobile app authorization bypass through rooted or jailbroken devices or debug modes
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "mobile" or Message contains "local" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MOB-004

rules.name: Mobile — Intent Spoofing and Deep Link Abuse
rules.description: Detects Android intent spoofing or iOS deep link abuse for unauthorized actions
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'intent_spoofing' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Certificate Pinning Bypass
rules.description: Detects SSL/TLS certificate pinning bypass attempts on mobile applications
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'certificate_pinning' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Sensitive Data in Logs
rules.description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, or PII logged by mobile applications in cleartext
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'logging' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Clipboard Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects mobile apps exposing sensitive data through the system clipboard
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'clipboard' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Biometric Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass biometric authentication on mobile devices
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'biometric' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Mobile — Screenshot and Screen Recording Detection
rules.description: Detects screen capture or recording while sensitive content is displayed on mobile devices
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'screen_capture' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5
